text: frames_routing.ath: math/routing/check.py passes. On all 106932 connected graphs on 2..5 vertices with edge weights in {1,2,3}, Dijkstra, A* (halved exact distance; one-landmark ALT) and contraction hierarchies (fixed order; every order for n<=4) give the Floyd-Warshall distance for every pair. A* with the halved heuristic never settles more nodes than Dijkstra; ALT can, on ties (12431 queries). Max hitting time over hop distance is n^2-3n+3 for n=2..5.
routing: max shortcuts of contraction in order 0..n-1, weights 1..3, n=2..5
routing: max over connected n-stop graphs of hitting time / hop distance, n=2..5
Routing: planned routes against haphazard buses
